(Per M. S. Sonak, J.)
1. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
2. Rule.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: The rule is made returnable immediately at the request of and with the consent of the learned counsel for the parties.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text:
3. Petitioner seeks the following substantive relief by instituting this Petition:-
"(b) By an appropriate Writ, Order, direction of this Hon'ble Court, this Hon'ble Court be pleased to call for papers and proceedings of the alleged acquisition of the piece and parcel of land bearing No.PTS 122/171-A admeasuring 481 square meters at Jalandhar Beach, Village Diu, Tehsil and District Diu owned, possessed and occupied by the Petitioner along with the structure standing thereon and after examining the legality and propriety thereof, be pleased to quash and set aside the said alleged acquisition;"
Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/86794002/
2 4.

sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text:
Mrs Harsha Palav, learned counsel for the Petitioner, has raised the following grounds in support the challenge:-
(a) There is no public purpose involved in the impugned acquisition.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: The existence of public purpose is a sine qua non for valid acquisition.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: WP-2810.25.DOCX (b) Acquisition for a new Government Guest House/Circuit House is not a tourism project.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: Therefore, it cannot be regarded as a public purpose as defined under Section 3 (za) r/w Section 2 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 ("the 2013 Act").

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: (c) Though the Petitioner filed his objections to the proposed acquisition, no opportunity of hearing as contemplated by Section 15 of the 2013 Act was granted to the Petitioner.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: Any acquisition without an opportunity of hearing is illegal, arbitrary and ultra vires of the 2013 Act.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: (d) The locality already has 7 Guest Houses/Circuit Houses.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: Therefore, acquiring additional land for such Guest House/ Circuit House does not constitute a public purpose.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: (e) The Respondents have let out or entered into arrangements with private parties to operate Guest Houses/Circuit Houses in the locality.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: Therefore, the proposed purpose is not public purpose.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: (f) The Petitioner is operating the Guest House/Circuit House, which is now proposed to be demolished, and the WP-2810.25.DOCX new Guest House/Circuit House has been erected in its place for the last 35 years.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: Therefore, the proposed acquisition will severely affect the Petitioner without any corresponding benefit to the Respondent.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: 5. Apart from the above contentions which we noted and reproduced, no other contentions were raised during arguments.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: There was no whisper of any malafides.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: There was no other breach of procedure alleged.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text:
6. Mr. Harsh Dedhia, learned counsel for the Respondents, countered the above contentions, inter alia, by referring to the 2013 Act and the Affidavit filed by Dharmendra Ratilal Damania,
Mamalatdar of Diu of Union Territory for Daman Diu and Dadra Nagar Haveli.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: He submitted that the Petitioner never filed objections within the prescribed period.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: He submitted that the acquisition was for a public purpose and that all lawful procedures had been followed.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: He submitted that the Petitioner had stalled the public project and, therefore, the Respondent had applied for an expeditious hearing of this matter.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: He urged the dismissal of this petition.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: 7. The rival contentions now fall for our determination.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: 8. The acquisition in the present case was initiated with the issue of Social Impact Assessment Notification dated 13 August WP-2810.25.DOCX 2021 under Section 4 of the 2013 Act.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text:
(See Exhibit Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/86794002/
3 D at paged 29 and 30 of the paper book of this Petition).

entities.text: Exhibit Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: After that, U.T. Administration Order dated 02 September 2021 constituted the Social Impact Assessment Team under 2013 Act.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: (See Exhibit - E at page 32).
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: 9. A Preliminary Notification dated 06 December 2021 under Section 11(1) of the 2013 Act was issued.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: (See Exhibit - G, pages 36 to 38).
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text:
The Preliminary Notification dated 06 December 2021 stated that land admeasuring 1767 sq.mtrs was required as additional land for construction of Government Guest House in place of existing Circuit House Annexe Building at Jalandhar Beach,
Diu, for public purpose as defined in Section 2(1)(vi) of the 2013 Act.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: This Preliminary Notification also gives the opportunity to the persons interested in objecting to the acquisition to file objections within 60 days from the date of publication of the notification as provided under Section 15 of the 2013 Act before the Collector.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: 10. Admittedly, Ms. Palav could not show that the Petitioner had filed objections within this 60-day period.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: The objections were filed only on 30 March 2022 (Exhibit-I) after the publication of the Declaration dated 29 March 2022 under Section 19(2) of the 2013 Act (Exhibit-H at pages 39 & 40).
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: Therefore, the petitioner cannot be heard to complain of the lack of hearing.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json
Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: . In the Affidavit filed on behalf of the Respondents, it is stated that a hearing on objections was scheduled for 04 March 2022.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text:
However, since no objections were received from any persons,
including the Petitioner, the acquisition proceedings proceeded by seeking necessary approval from the Administrator.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: The Affidavit also explains the further steps taken for the acquisition consistent with the provisions of the 2013 Act.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: There is no case made out to doubt the averments made in the Respondents' Affidavit in Reply.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: Even no rejoinder was shown to us or relied upon.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: 12. The argument that no public purpose was involved in the acquisition cannot be accepted.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text:
Section 2 (za) provides that public purpose means the activities specified under subsection (1) of Section 2.
Section 2(1) is quite exhaustive, and it states that the provisions of the 2013 Act will apply when the appropriate government acquires land for its own use and for a public purpose and shall include,
inter alia, projects for sports, health care, tourism, and transportation of space programmes.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: The definition is inclusive.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: 13. In Manimegalai Vs the Special Tehsildar1, the Hon'ble Supreme Court has held that public purpose is incapable of precise definition.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: Each case has to be considered in light of the purpose 1 AIR 2018 SC 2020 WP-2810.25.DOCX for which the acquisition is sought for.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: It is to serve the general interest of the community instead of the individual's particular interest.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: Public purpose broadly speaking would include the purpose in which the general interest of the society as opposed to the particular interest of the individual, is directly and vitally concerned.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: Generally, the executive would be the best judge to determine whether or not the impugned purpose is a public purpose.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: 14. In this case, the public purpose is to construct a government guest house in place of the existing circuit house and the Annexe Building at Jalandhar Beach, Diu.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text:
The Affidavit states that the tourism Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/86794002/
4 department initiated this acquisition.

entities.text: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: Social Impact Assessment was undertaken, and its report was evaluated, and its recommendations were considered.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: The Social Impact Assessment Report was placed in the public domain by uploading it on the government website.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: Thus, all legal procedures prescribed under the 2013 Act were complied with.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: No arguments were made regarding these compliances.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: 15. The record shows that the existing Circuit House Annexe, in place of which construction of a government Guest House is proposed, is at the Jalandhar Beach in Diu.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: The tourism department initiated this proposal.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: Ms. Palav's contention that a Circuit House or a government Guest House is only a place for WP-2810.25.DOCX government servants to stay when on official work may not be accurate.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: They may be accommodated at such guest houses while availing of LTC or even otherwise on visits.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: To say that the public purpose of constructing a Guest House at Jalandhar Beach has no nexus with tourism would not be correct.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: The definition of public purpose is inclusive.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: Even if used for government servants when on duty, it would be for public purpose because government servants are rendering public duty.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: 16. From the perusal of the Petitioner's belated objections dated 30 March 2022, we cannot say that the acquisition, in this case, is not for the public purpose of tourism or has no nexus with tourism.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: The Petitioner has himself stated that the Guest House, which is proposed to be acquired, is a landmark for Diu.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: It finds mention in many international travel guides.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: Thousands of international travellers have stayed and dined in this guest house and written nostalgic reviews about this property.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: It has played a major role in bringing Diu to the International Tourist Map.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: The Petitioner has stated that the government has not recognized the important contribution of this Guest House in attracting tourism footfall.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: 17. After considering all these factors cumulatively, we cannot accept that the acquisition, in this case, is not for a public purpose.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: Even the Petitioner does not contend that the acquisition is for some private purpose.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: No malafides are alleged, and no arguments WP-2810.25.DOCX were made alleging malafides.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: The arguments about several other guest houses in the locality or that the petitioner was himself operating a guest house for the last 35 years are not reasonable enough grounds to strike down acquisition proceedings.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: In exercising judicial review, the Courts are not concerned with the wisdom or commercial expediency of the project.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: They are concerned with the legality.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: 18. The Petitioner's contention that he was not given any opportunity of hearing as contemplated by Section 15 of the 2013 Act also cannot be accepted.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: The record shows that vide Preliminary Notification dated 06 December 2021, the Petitioner was granted an opportunity to file his objections, if any, within 60 days from the publication of the Notification as required under Section 15 of the 2013 Act.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: Admittedly, no such objections were filed by the Petitioner within 60 days of publishing the Preliminary Notification dated 06 December 2021.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text:
19. Only after the Declaration under Section 19(2) was issued on 29 March 2022, the Petitioner purported to raise objections via communication dated 30 March 2022 (Exhibit I on pages 41 to Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/86794002/
5 45).

entities.text: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: Since the objections were filed beyond the prescribed period and even after the Declaration under Section 19(2) of the 2013 Act was made, the Petitioner cannot be heard to complain of denial of WP-2810.25.DOCX opportunity of hearing or complain that his objections were not considered.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: No breach of section 15 can, therefore, be inferred.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: 20. Even perusal of the Petitioner's belated objections dated 30 March 2022 would show that the same transgresses the parameters of Section 15(1) of the 2013 Act.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: Only if the objections are made can the objector insist on an opportunity to be heard in person, or any person authorized by him or by an Advocate.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: Since, in this case, the Petitioner filed no objection within the prescribed period or even until the declaration was made under Section 19(2), the Petitioner cannot even call himself an objector and insist upon an opportunity of hearing in terms of Section15(2) of the 2013 Act.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: 21. The Petitioner's argument about there being seven Guest Houses in the locality or that the Respondents have entered arrangements with private parties for operating Guest Houses, or that the Petitioner is operating a Guest House which is now proposed to be demolished are not valid grounds to strike down the acquisition notifications.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: If the petitioner perceives any illegalities in the government's transactions, he can always question such transactions or arrangements following the law.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text:
However, based on such arguments, the acquisition cannot be struck down or conclude that the acquisition is not for a public purpose.
WP-2810.25.DOCX 22.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: No doubt, the Petitioner might have to face some hardship.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: But that is not the ground to quash valid acquisition proceedings.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: Regarding the quantum of compensation, the Respondents' Affidavit states that such an issue can always be raised before the competent authority and that compensation will be provided in accordance with the law.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: 23. We dismiss this Petition and vacate the ad-interim relief for all the above reasons.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text:
There shall,
however, be no order for costs.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

sentences.text: 24. All concerned to act upon an authenticated copy of this order.
sentences._hearing_file: Uday Mansuclal vs Union Territory Of Dadra And Nagar ... on 7 March, 2025.json

opennyai_summary.7_March_2025__arguments: The existence of public purpose is a sine qua non for valid acquisition.
opennyai_summary.7_March_2025__facts:
WP-2810.25.DOCX (b) Acquisition for a new Government Guest House/Circuit House is not a tourism project.
Therefore, it cannot be regarded as a public purpose as defined under Section 3 (za) r/w Section 2 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 ("the 2013 Act").
(c) Though the Petitioner filed his objections to the proposed acquisition, no opportunity of hearing as contemplated by Section 15 of the 2013 Act was granted to the Petitioner.
Any acquisition without an opportunity of hearing is illegal, arbitrary and ultra vires of the 2013 Act.
(d) The locality already has 7 Guest Houses/Circuit Houses.
Therefore, acquiring additional land for such Guest House/ Circuit House does not constitute a public purpose.
(e) The Respondents have let out or entered into arrangements with private parties to operate Guest Houses/Circuit Houses in the locality.
Therefore, the proposed purpose is not public purpose.
opennyai_summary.7_March_2025__ANALYSIS:
It is to serve the general interest of the community instead of the individual's particular interest.
Public purpose broadly speaking would include the purpose in which the general interest of the society as opposed to the particular interest of the individual, is directly and vitally concerned.
Generally, the executive would be the best judge to determine whether or not the impugned purpose is a public purpose.
16. From the perusal of the Petitioner's belated objections dated 30 March 2022, we cannot say that the acquisition, in this case, is not for the public purpose of tourism or has no nexus with tourism.
In exercising judicial review, the Courts are not concerned with the wisdom or commercial expediency of the project.
Since the objections were filed beyond the prescribed period and even after the Declaration under Section 19(2) of the 2013 Act was made, the Petitioner cannot be heard to complain of denial of WP-2810.25.DOCX opportunity of hearing or complain that his objections were not considered.
No breach of section 15 can, therefore, be inferred.
20. Even perusal of the Petitioner's belated objections dated 30 March 2022 would show that the same transgresses the parameters of Section 15(1) of the 2013 Act.
Only if the objections are made can the objector insist on an opportunity to be heard in person, or any person authorized by him or by an Advocate.
Since, in this case, the Petitioner filed no objection within the prescribed period or even until the declaration was made under Section 19(2), the Petitioner cannot even call himself an objector and insist upon an opportunity of hearing in terms of Section15(2) of the 2013 Act.
opennyai_summary.7_March_2025__decision:
23. We dismiss this Petition and vacate the ad-interim relief for all the above reasons.
There shall,
however, be no order for costs.
24. All concerned to act upon an authenticated copy of this order.
